method: Read immutable source snapshots once. Run a disposable original-source native check concurrently with source/index work. Join before projection writes, discard its diagnostics, synchronize every generated change, then check the final state normally. Discovery needing other namespaces and new external roots use the existing fresh checker.
sdk_modes: Native fields off/on and warmup off/on
